verses.sloka: तस्य आलय वरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलम् आयतम् ।ददर्श भवन श्रेष्ठम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-९-१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya ālaya variṣṭhasya madhye vipulam āyatam ।dadarśa bhavana śreṣṭham hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ॥5-9-1॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, saw a huge, spacious and excellent of all mansions in the centre of the palace.

verses.sloka: अर्ध योजन विस्तीर्णम् आयतम् योजनम् हि तत् ।भवनम् राक्षस इन्द्रस्य बहु प्रासाद सम्कुलम् ॥५-९-२॥
verses.transliteration: ardha yojana vistīrṇam āyatam yojanam hi tat ।bhavanam rākṣasa indrasya bahu prāsāda samkulam ॥5-9-2॥

translations.english: The mansion of the lord of demons was a conglomeration of palaces half a yojana long and half a yojana wide.
translations.hindi: उस पलेंग पर हाथीदाँत श्रौर सोने से चित्रकारी (नक्काशी का काम) की गई थी श्रौर जगह-जगह पन्ने जड़े हुए थे । उसके ऊपर बड़े मूल्यवान्‌ श्रौर कोमल बिछोने बिछे थे

verses.sloka: मार्गमाणः तु वैदेहीम् सीताम् आयत लोचनाम् ।सर्वतः परिचक्राम हनूमान् अरि सूदनः ॥५-९-३॥
verses.transliteration: mārgamāṇaḥ tu vaidehīm sītām āyata locanām ।sarvataḥ paricakrāma hanūmān ari sūdanaḥ ॥5-9-3॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the subduer of enemies, went around in search of the largeeyed Vaidehi.
translations.hindi: उस शयनशाला में एक विशेष स्थान पर सफेद रंग का, चन्द्रमा की वरह चमकता, एक छत्र रखा था । वह छत्र दिव्य-पुष्पों की माला से भूषित था

verses.sloka: उत्तमम् राक्षसावासम् हनुमानवलोकयन् ।आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् ॥५-९-४॥
verses.transliteration: uttamam rākṣasāvāsam hanumānavalokayan ।āsasādātha lakṣmīvān rākṣasendraniveśanam ॥5-9-4॥

translations.english: Searching the excellent residences of important demons, Hanuman finally reached the palace of the lord of ogres guarded by armed demons with elephants with two or three or four tusks.
translations.hindi: वहाँ सुवणं का बना हुआ, सूर्यसम चमकीला और श्रशोक पुष्पों की साला से प्रलङ कृत एक पलंग हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: चतुर् विषाणैर् द्विरदैः त्रिविषाणैः तथैव च ।परिक्षिप्तम् असम्बाधम् रक्ष्यमाणम् उदायुधैः ॥५-९-५॥
verses.transliteration: catur viṣāṇair dviradaiḥ triviṣāṇaiḥ tathaiva ca ।parikṣiptam asambādham rakṣyamāṇam udāyudhaiḥ ॥5-9-5॥

translations.english: Searching the excellent residences of important demons, Hanuman finally reached the palace of the lord of ogres guarded by armed demons with elephants with two or three or four tusks.

verses.sloka: राक्षसीभिः च पत्नीभी रावणस्य निवेशनम् ।आह्Rताभिः च विक्रम्य राज कन्याभिर् आव्Rतम् ॥५-९-६॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasībhiḥ ca patnībhī rāvaṇasya niveśanam ।āhRtābhiḥ ca vikramya rāja kanyābhir āvRtam ॥5-9-6॥

translations.english: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.
translations.hindi: वह पलंग कोमल पशमीने से मढ़ा था, कोमल विस्तर उस पर बिले हुये थे । उसके चारों ग्रोर फूलों के हार लटक रहे थे

verses.sloka: तन् नक्र मकर आकीर्णम् तिमिम्गिल झष आकुलम् ।वायु वेग समाधूतम् पन्नगैर् इव सागरम् ॥५-९-७॥
verses.transliteration: tan nakra makara ākīrṇam timimgila jhaṣa ākulam ।vāyu vega samādhūtam pannagair iva sāgaram ॥5-9-7॥

translations.english: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.
translations.hindi: उस पलंग पर काले मेघ की तरह काले रंग का, कानों में उत्तम प्रौर चमकते हुए कुण्डल पहिने हुए, लाल-लाल नेत्रों वाला, बड़ी भुजाग्रों वाला, कलावत्तू के काम के कपड़े धारण किए हुए

verses.sloka: या हि वैश्वरणे लक्ष्मीर् या च इन्द्रे हरि वाहने ।सा रावण ग्Rहे सर्वा नित्यम् एव अनपायिनी ॥५-९-८॥
verses.transliteration: yā hi vaiśvaraṇe lakṣmīr yā ca indre hari vāhane ।sā rāvaṇa gRhe sarvā nityam eva anapāyinī ॥5-9-8॥

translations.english: Whatever wealth was possessed by Vaisravana (Kubera, the son of sage Vishrava) and also Indra who rides the Ucchaisrava green horse, was there in the palace of Ravana.
translations.hindi: सब शरीर में लाल चन्दन लगाए, दामिनी सहित सन्ध्याकालीन लाल बादल की तरह शोभायमान किए हुए

verses.sloka: या च राज्ञः कुबेरस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च ।ताद्Rशी तद् विशिष्टा वा Rद्धी रक्षो ग्Rहेष्व् इह ॥५-९-९॥
verses.transliteration: yā ca rājñaḥ kuberasya yamasya varuṇasya ca ।tādRśī tad viśiṣṭā vā Rddhī rakṣo gRheṣv iha ॥5-9-9॥

translations.english: The wealth stored in Ravana's palace was akin to what lay in the palaces of Kubera, Yama or Varuna, and ever more exquisite.
translations.hindi: इस पलंग के आसपास सुन्दर पुतलियाँ हाथों में चेवर श्रौर पंखा से हवा कर रही थीं । वहाँ परं विविध प्रकार के इत्र रखे हुए थे भोर उत्तम सुगन्धि की धूप जल रही थी, जिससे वह स्थान सुवासित हो रहा था

verses.sloka: तस्य हर्म्यस्य मध्यस्थम् वेश्म च अन्यत् सुनिर्मितम् ।बहुनिर्यूह सम्कीर्णम् ददर्श पवन आत्मजः ॥५-९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tasya harmyasya madhyastham veśma ca anyat sunirmitam ।bahuniryūha samkīrṇam dadarśa pavana ātmajaḥ ॥5-9-10॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw in the centre of that palace a complex of many wellbuilt houses.
translations.hindi: रावण रात को विहार करते-करते थका हुआ, मदिरापान किए हुए शा । बहू राक्षस-कत्याग्नों का प्रिय था श्रौर राक्षसों को सुख देने वाला था

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मणो अर्थे क्Rतम् दिव्यम् दिवि यद् विश्व कर्मणा ।विमानम् पुष्पकम् नाम सर्व रत्न विभूषितम् ॥५-९-११॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo arthe kRtam divyam divi yad viśva karmaṇā ।vimānam puṣpakam nāma sarva ratna vibhūṣitam ॥5-9-11॥

translations.english: There was a wonderful aerial chariot called Pushpaka embellished with all kinds of gems built by Visvakarma for Brahma. It was the same one that Kubera had won from his grandfather, the creator Brahma, through his supreme penance. The lord of ogres acquired it (as a memento for his victory) by defeating Kubera with his might.
translations.hindi: मदिरापान एवं स्त्रियों के साथ क्रीड़ा करके तृप्त हो सुवर्णे से चमचमाते पलंग पर शयन किये हुए वीर राक्षसराज को हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: परेण तपसा लेभे यत् कुबेरः पितामहात् ।कुबेरम् ओजसा जित्वा लेभे तद् राक्षस ईश्वरः ॥५-९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: pareṇa tapasā lebhe yat kuberaḥ pitāmahāt ।kuberam ojasā jitvā lebhe tad rākṣasa īśvaraḥ ॥5-9-12॥

translations.english: There was a wonderful aerial chariot called Pushpaka embellished with all kinds of gems built by Visvakarma for Brahma. It was the same one that Kubera had won from his grandfather, the creator Brahma, through his supreme penance. The lord of ogres acquired it (as a memento for his victory) by defeating Kubera with his might.
translations.hindi: सोते में रावण हाथी की तरह श्वास छोड़ रहा था । हनुमान रावण को देख घबड़ा कर डरे हुए मनुष्य की तरह उस जगह से कुछ दूर हट कर सीढ़ी की आड़ में एक चबूतरे पर खड़े हो गए और वहाँ से राक्षसराज को देखने लगे

verses.sloka: ईहा म्Rग समायुक्तैः कार्य स्वर हिरण्मयैः ।सुक्Rतैर् आचितम् स्तम्भैः प्रदीप्तम् इव च श्रिया ॥५-९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: īhā mRga samāyuktaiḥ kārya svara hiraṇmayaiḥ ।sukRtair ācitam stambhaiḥ pradīptam iva ca śriyā ॥5-9-13॥

translations.english: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.

verses.sloka: मेरु मन्दर सम्काशैर् उल्लिखद्भिर् इव अम्बरम् ।कूट अगारैः शुभ आकारैः सर्वतः समलम्क्Rतम् ॥५-९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: meru mandara samkāśair ullikhadbhir iva ambaram ।kūṭa agāraiḥ śubha ākāraiḥ sarvataḥ samalamkRtam ॥5-9-14॥

translations.english: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.
translations.hindi: सोते हुए रावण का पलंग ऐसा शोभायमान हो रहा था, जैसे वह पहाड़ी झरना शोभायमान होता है, जिसके निकट मदमत्त हाथी: सोता हो

verses.sloka: ज्वलन अर्क प्रतीकाशम् सुक्Rतम् विश्व कर्मणा ।हेम सोपान सम्युक्तम् चारु प्रवर वेदिकम् ॥५-९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: jvalana arka pratīkāśam sukRtam viśva karmaṇā ।hema sopāna samyuktam cāru pravara vedikam ॥5-9-15॥

translations.english: It was well built by Visvakarma and and had golden stairways, with radiant platforms glowing like fire and Sun.
translations.hindi: रावण की दोनों भुजाएं जो वाजूबन्दों से श्र॒लंकृत थीं और जिनको पसार कर वह सो रहा था, इन्द्रध्वज की तरह जान पड़ती थीं

verses.sloka: जाल वात अयनैर् युक्तम् कान्चनैः स्थाटिकैर् अपि ।इन्द्र नील महा नील मणि प्रवरवेदिकम् ॥५-९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: jāla vāta ayanair yuktam kāncanaiḥ sthāṭikair api ।indra nīla mahā nīla maṇi pravaravedikam ॥5-9-16॥

translations.english: It had latticed windows made of gold inlaid with crystals. The platforms were encrusted with saphires called Indraneela and Mahaneela appropriately.
translations.hindi: उसकी दोनों भुजाश्रों पर ऐरावत के दांतों के आघात के चिह्नं थे । कंधों पर वज्र के आघात के निशान थे । सुदर्शनचक्र के लगने के भी उसकी दोनों भुजाश्रों पर निशान बने हुए थे

verses.sloka: विद्रुमेण विचित्रेण मणिभिश्च महाधनैः ।विस्तुलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिस्तलेनाभिविराजितम् ॥५-९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: vidrumeṇa vicitreṇa maṇibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ ।vistulābhiśca muktābhistalenābhivirājitam ॥5-9-17॥

translations.english: It was shining bright with colourful corals, precious gems and peerless pearls fixed on its floor.
translations.hindi: उसकी दोनों लम्बी भुजाएँ मोटी श्रौर शरीर के अनुरूप एवं बलयुक्त थीं । उसकी अंगुलियाँ और ग्रंगूठे के नख सुलक्षण युक्त थे और ग्रंगुलियाँ सुन्दर-सुन्दर श्रंगूठियों से भूषित थीं

verses.sloka: चन्दनेन च रक्तेन तपनीयनिभेन च ।सुपुण्यगन्धिना युक्तमादित्यतरुणोपमम् ॥५-९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: candanena ca raktena tapanīyanibhena ca ।supuṇyagandhinā yuktamādityataruṇopamam ॥5-9-18॥

translations.english: It was bright like molten gold, fragrant with red sandal comparable to the rising Sun.
translations.hindi: रावण की भुजाएं, ) मोटी, परिघ के आकार वाली, हाथी की सूड की तरह उतार चढाव की और पलंग पर फैली हुई ऐसी जान पड़ती थीं, मानों पाँच सिर वाले सपं हों

verses.sloka: कूटागारैर्वराकारैर्विविधैः समलम्कृतम् ।विमानम् पुष्पकम् दिव्यम् आरुरोह महा कपिः ॥५-९-१९॥
verses.transliteration: kūṭāgārairvarākārairvividhaiḥ samalamkṛtam ।vimānam puṣpakam divyam āruroha mahā kapiḥ ॥5-9-19॥

translations.english: Hanuman ascended the wonderful Pushpaka, welldecked with many corridors.

verses.sloka: तत्रस्थः स तदा गन्धम् पान भक्ष्य अन्न सम्भवम् ।दिव्यम् सम्मूर्चितम् जिघ्रन् रूपवन्तम् इव अनिलम् ॥५-९-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tatrasthaḥ sa tadā gandham pāna bhakṣya anna sambhavam ।divyam sammūrcitam jighran rūpavantam iva anilam ॥5-9-20॥

translations.english: There he smelt the stupefying, unearthly odour of food and drink. He felt as though the fragrance had taken a potentially solid form. (Note: The wind has no form. But when he carried the aroma of food and drink it appeared like the personification of wind which could be smelt. गन्धवती पृथवी fragrance comes from earth पृथवीतत्त्व the poet transmits the same to the wind who has got only स्पर्श sense of touch).
translations.hindi: सुन्दरी स्त्रियों के ्रालिगन से मदित, अत्यन्त सुगन्धित द्रव्यों से सेवित, यक्ष, नाग, गन्धं, देव और दानवों को रुला देने वाली

verses.sloka: स गन्धः तम् महा सत्त्वम् बन्धुर् बन्धुम् इव उत्तमम् ।इत एहि इति उवाच इव तत्र यत्र स रावणः ॥५-९-२१॥
verses.transliteration: sa gandhaḥ tam mahā sattvam bandhur bandhum iva uttamam ।ita ehi iti uvāca iva tatra yatra sa rāvaṇaḥ ॥5-9-21॥

translations.english: The fragrance was as if inviting the mighty hero like a relative inviting his kith and kin, saying 'come here' and leading him to a place where Ravana rested.
translations.hindi: और बिछौने पर फैली हुई दोनों भुजाग्रों को हनुमानजी ने देखा। उस समय वे दोनों भुजाएं एसी जान पड़ती थी, मानों मन्दराचल पर्वत की तलेटी में दो क्रुद्ध सर्प सो रहे हों

verses.sloka: ततः ताम् प्रस्थितः शालाम् ददर्श महतीम् शुभाम् ।रावणस्य मनः कान्ताम् कान्ताम् इव वर स्त्रियम् ॥५-९-२२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tām prasthitaḥ śālām dadarśa mahatīm śubhām ।rāvaṇasya manaḥ kāntām kāntām iva vara striyam ॥5-9-22॥

translations.english: Then he proceeded to an auspicious hall, which was Ravana's favourite like his chief queen dear to his heart.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों भुजाग्रों से रावण, दो शिखरों से शोभित मन्दराचल की तरह झोभायमान हो रहा था

verses.sloka: मणि सोपान विक्Rताम् हेम जाल विराजिताम् ।स्फाटिकैर् आव्Rत तलाम् दन्त अन्तरित रूपिकाम् ॥५-९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: maṇi sopāna vikRtām hema jāla virājitām ।sphāṭikair āvRta talām danta antarita rūpikām ॥5-9-23॥

translations.english: The stairways of the mansion were inlaid with special gems, windows were latticed with gold, floors were covered with crystals, figures of ivory with silver.
translations.hindi: उस राक्षसराज रावण के बड़े मुख से निकली हुई सांसे, जो श्राम, नागकेसर और मौलसिरी के पुष्पों की सुगन्धि से सुवासित थीं तया जिनमें पड्रस युकत ग्रन्न तथा शराब की गन्ध मिश्रित थीं, उस सम्पूर्ण शयनशाला को सुवासित कर रही थीं

verses.sloka: मुक्ताभिः च प्रवालैः च रूप्य चामी करैर् अपि ।विभूषिताम् मणि स्तम्भैः सुबहु स्तम्भ भूषिताम् ॥५-९-२४॥
verses.transliteration: muktābhiḥ ca pravālaiḥ ca rūpya cāmī karair api ।vibhūṣitām maṇi stambhaiḥ subahu stambha bhūṣitām ॥5-9-24॥

translations.english: It was decorated with pillars of silver and gold inlaid with pearls and corals and gems.

verses.sloka: नम्रैरृजुभिरत्युच्चैः समन्तात्सुविभूषितैः ।स्तम्भैः पक्षैर् इव अत्युच्चैर् दिवम् सम्प्रस्थिताम् इव ॥५-९-२५॥
verses.transliteration: namrairṛjubhiratyuccaiḥ samantātsuvibhūṣitaiḥ ।stambhaiḥ pakṣair iva atyuccair divam samprasthitām iva ॥5-9-25॥

translations.english: It had highly ornamented pillars all over, some slightly bent and others straight. With lofty columns looking like wings it appeared as if the mansion had started on its journey to heaven.
translations.hindi: विचित्र मोतियों ग्रौर मणियों के जड़ाऊ सोने के मुकुट से, जो सोते में अपने स्यान से कुछ खसक गया था तथा कुण्डलों से उसका मुख बड़ा सुन्दर जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: महत्या कुथय आस्त्रीणम् प्Rथिवी लक्षण अन्कया ।पृथिवीम् इव विस्तीर्णाम् सराष्ट्र ग्Rह मालिनीम् ॥५-९-२६॥
verses.transliteration: mahatyā kuthaya āstrīṇam pRthivī lakṣaṇa ankayā ।pṛthivīm iva vistīrṇām sarāṣṭra gRha mālinīm ॥5-9-26॥

translations.english: The floor was covered with a wide carpet spread from wall to wall with designs of different murals of many places and houses drawn in a row (garland like). The big carpet appeared like the expanse of earth itself.
translations.hindi: भ्रपवृत्ते--स्यानात्किच्चिच्चलितेन । (गो०) उसका मासल और चौड़ा वक्षःस्थल लाल चन्दन श्रौर सुन्दर हार से अलंकृत था

verses.sloka: नादिताम् मत्त विहगैर् दिव्य गन्ध अधिवासिताम् ।पर अर्ध्य आस्तरण उपेताम् रक्षो अधिप निषेविताम् ॥५-९-२७॥
verses.transliteration: nāditām matta vihagair divya gandha adhivāsitām ।para ardhya āstaraṇa upetām rakṣo adhipa niṣevitām ॥5-9-27॥

translations.english: The mansion was resounding with the noise of birds singing in heat. It had wonderful fragrance. It was laid with exquisite tapestries and served as a dwelling place for the king of demons.
translations.hindi: वह सफेद रेशमी धोती पहिने हुए था और बढ़िया पीले रंग का डपट्टा ग्रोढ़े हुए था

verses.sloka: धूम्राम् अगरु धूपेन विमलाम् हम्स पाण्डुराम् ।चित्राम् पुष्प उपहारेण कल्माषीम् इव सुप्रभाम् ॥५-९-२८॥
verses.transliteration: dhūmrām agaru dhūpena vimalām hamsa pāṇḍurām ।citrām puṣpa upahāreṇa kalmāṣīm iva suprabhām ॥5-9-28॥

translations.english: It was smoky with fumes of agaru incence though spotless like a swan. It was colourful and radiant like Kamadhenu, the wishfulfilling cow, because of the offering of flowers.
translations.hindi: रावण सोता हुम्ना उदों के ढेर की तरह जान पड़ता था । वह सांप की फूफकार की तरह सांस लेता हुआ, पलंग पर पड़ा एसा सो रहा था मानों गंगाजी के गहरे जल में पड़ा सोता हो

verses.sloka: मनः सम्ह्लाद जननीम् वर्णस्य अपि प्रसादिनीम् ।ताम् शोक नाशिनीम् दिव्याम् श्रियः सम्जननीम् इव ॥५-९-२९॥
verses.transliteration: manaḥ samhlāda jananīm varṇasya api prasādinīm ।tām śoka nāśinīm divyām śriyaḥ samjananīm iva ॥5-9-29॥

translations.english: (The mansion) was so full of effulgence and soul ravishing that it served as an adornment even to splendour. It looked as though it banished all sorrow and was a source of prosperity.

verses.sloka: इन्द्रियाणि इन्द्रिय अर्थैः तु पन्च पन्चभिर् उत्तमैः ।तर्पयाम् आस माता इव तदा रावण पालिता ॥५-९-३०॥
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi indriya arthaiḥ tu panca pancabhir uttamaiḥ ।tarpayām āsa mātā iva tadā rāvaṇa pālitā ॥5-9-30॥

translations.english: The chamber of Ravana, like a mother, gratified all the five senses of Hanuman with proper objects of the senses.

verses.sloka: स्वर्गो अयम् देव लोको अयम् इन्द्रस्य इयम् पुरी भवेत् ।सिद्धिर् वा इयम् परा हि स्याद् इति अमन्यत मारुतिः ॥५-९-३१॥
verses.transliteration: svargo ayam deva loko ayam indrasya iyam purī bhavet ।siddhir vā iyam parā hi syād iti amanyata mārutiḥ ॥5-9-31॥

translations.english: 'This may be heaven or world of gods. It may be Amaravati, the abode of Indra or else it may be the supreme achievment (of the Creator), thought Maruti৷৷

verses.sloka: प्रध्यायत इव अपश्यत् प्रदीपामः तत्र कान्चनान् (ःइअतुस्!)।धूर्तान् इव महा धूर्तैर् देवनेन पराजितान् ॥५-९-३२॥
verses.transliteration: pradhyāyata iva apaśyat pradīpāmaḥ tatra kāncanān (ḥiatus!)।dhūrtān iva mahā dhūrtair devanena parājitān ॥5-9-32॥

translations.english: Seeing the golden lamps that stood burning steadily, Hanuman thought they looked like gamblers in deep thought defeated by expert gamblers in a game of dice.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, वे सब स्त्रियां जो रावण की भुजाम्रों के बीच तथा गोद में पड़ी थीं नाचने गाने में निपुण थीं श्रौर श्रच्छे-श्रच्छे गहने पहिने हुए, सो रही थीं

verses.sloka: दीपानाम् च प्रकाशेन तेजसा रावणस्य च ।अर्चिर्भिर् भूषणानाम् च प्रदीप्ता इति अभ्यमन्यत ॥५-९-३३॥
verses.transliteration: dīpānām ca prakāśena tejasā rāvaṇasya ca ।arcirbhir bhūṣaṇānām ca pradīptā iti abhyamanyata ॥5-9-33॥

translations.english: Hanuman fancied that the entire place was set ablaze with the glow of lamps, the lustre of Ravana and the brilliant glow of Ravana's ornaments (everything was shining).
translations.hindi: उनके कानों में सोने के तथा हीरों पन्नों के जड़ाऊ कर्णफूल लटक रहे ये । हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, वे स्त्रियां भुजाश्रों में जो बाजूबन्द पहिने हुए थीं, भुजाश्रों का तकिया लगाने से, वे भी कानों के पास कुण्डलों के साथ शोभायमान हो रहे थे

verses.sloka: ततो अपश्यत् कुथा आसीनम् नाना वर्ण अम्बर स्रजम् ।सहस्रम् वर नारीणाम् नाना वेष विभूषितम् ॥५-९-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tato apaśyat kuthā āsīnam nānā varṇa ambara srajam ।sahasram vara nārīṇām nānā veṣa vibhūṣitam ॥5-9-34॥

translations.english: He found thousands of beautiful women seated on carpets wearing different clothes and garlands and dressed in various attires.
translations.hindi: उन स्त्रियों के चन्द्रमा के समान मुखों और सुन्दर कुण्डलों से वह स्थान ससा शोभायमान हो रहा था, जैसे तारों से ग्राकाश की शोभा होती है

verses.sloka: परिव्Rत्ते अर्ध रात्रे तु पान निद्रा वशम् गतम् ।क्रीडित्वा उपरतम् रात्रौ सुष्वाप बलवत् तदा ॥५-९-३५॥
verses.transliteration: parivRtte ardha rātre tu pāna nidrā vaśam gatam ।krīḍitvā uparatam rātrau suṣvāpa balavat tadā ॥5-9-35॥

translations.english: Drinking and sporting until midnight, they had dropped off to sleeptired.
translations.hindi: मदिरा के नरे में चूर हो तथा नाचने गाने के परिश्रम से श्रत्यन्त खिन्न होकर, जहाँ जिसे जो जगह मिली वहीं पड़ कर, वे सो रही थीं

verses.sloka: तत् प्रसुप्तम् विरुरुचे निह्शब्द अन्तर भूषणम् ।निह्शब्द हम्स भ्रमरम् यथा पद्म वनम् महत् ॥५-९-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tat prasuptam viruruce nihśabda antara bhūṣaṇam ।nihśabda hamsa bhramaram yathā padma vanam mahat ॥5-9-36॥

translations.english: Fast asleep, sounds of their ornaments silenced, the young women looked like a large bed of lotuses with swans and bees sitting calm without their usual noise.
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई मनोहर कोमलाङ्गी कामिनी निद्रावस्था में श्रपने कोमल हाथों को हिला डुला रही थी, जिसको देखने से ऐसा जान पड़ता था, मानों वह हाव भाव दिखा कर नाच रही हो

verses.sloka: तासाम् सम्व्Rत दन्तानि मीलित अक्षाणि मारुतिः ।अपश्यत् पद्म गन्धीनि वदनानि सुयोषिताम् ॥५-९-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tāsām samvRta dantāni mīlita akṣāṇi mārutiḥ ।apaśyat padma gandhīni vadanāni suyoṣitām ॥5-9-37॥

translations.english: Hanuman looked at the faces of the wellbred young women with closed eyes and concealed teeth, fragrant like lotuses.
translations.hindi: कोई स्त्री वीणा को अपनी छाती से लिपटा कर सोजान से एसी जान पड़ती थी, मानों नदी की धार में डूबती हुई कमलिनी सौभाग्यवश किसी नाव से जा लिपटी हो

verses.sloka: प्रबुद्धानि इव पद्मानि तासाम् भूत्वा क्षपा क्षये ।पुनः सम्व्Rत पत्राणि रात्राव् इव बभुः तदा ॥५-९-३८॥
verses.transliteration: prabuddhāni iva padmāni tāsām bhūtvā kṣapā kṣaye ।punaḥ samvRta patrāṇi rātrāv iva babhuḥ tadā ॥5-9-38॥

translations.english: The faces of the women looked like blooming lotuses at daybreak, their petals closed up again at night.
translations.hindi: कमल के समान नेत्र वाली कोई स्त्री मड्डूक नामक वाद्य (बाजा) , विशेष को बगल में दवा, वैसे ही सो रही थी, जैसे कोई बालवत्सला स्त्री ग्रपने बालक को बगल में दवा सो रही हो

verses.sloka: इमानि मुख पद्मानि नियतम् मत्त षट्पदाः ।अम्बुजानि इव फुल्लानि प्रार्थयन्ति पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-३९॥
verses.transliteration: imāni mukha padmāni niyatam matta ṣaṭpadāḥ ।ambujāni iva phullāni prārthayanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-9-39॥

translations.english: The intoxicated bees would again and again long to enjoy these beautiful faces which were like blooming lotuses.

verses.sloka: इति वा अमन्यत श्रीमान् उपपत्त्या महा कपिः ।मेने हि गुणतः तानि समानि सलिल उद्भवैः ॥५-९-४०॥
verses.transliteration: iti vā amanyata śrīmān upapattyā mahā kapiḥ ।mene hi guṇataḥ tāni samāni salila udbhavaiḥ ॥5-9-40॥

translations.english: The illustrious Hanuman felt it to be correct to compare those faces with lotuses for their fragrance.
translations.hindi: कोई कंमललोचनी वंशी को पकड़ कर सो रही थी, मानों कोई कामिनी एकान्त में कामातुर हो, अपने प्यारे को पकड़ रही हो

verses.sloka: सा तस्य शुशुभे शाला ताभिः स्त्रीभिर् विराजिता ।शारदी इव प्रसन्ना द्यौः ताराभिर् अभिशोभिता ॥५-९-४१॥
verses.transliteration: sā tasya śuśubhe śālā tābhiḥ strībhir virājitā ।śāradī iva prasannā dyauḥ tārābhir abhiśobhitā ॥5-9-41॥

translations.english: Brightened by (the beauty of) the maidens, the mansion shone like the autumnal sky endearing and pleasing with stars.
translations.hindi: कोई नाचने वाली स्त्री वीणा को पकड़ कर ऐसे सो रही थी मानौं झपने पति के साथ पड़ी सो रही हो

verses.sloka: स च ताभिः परिव्Rतः शुशुभे राक्षस अधिपः ।यथा हि उडु पतिः श्रीमामः ताराभिर् अभिसम्व्Rतः ॥५-९-४२॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca tābhiḥ parivRtaḥ śuśubhe rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।yathā hi uḍu patiḥ śrīmāmaḥ tārābhir abhisamvRtaḥ ॥5-9-42॥

translations.english: The lord of demons surrounded by women shone like the beautiful Moon encircled by stars.
translations.hindi: कोई- कोई मदमाते नयनों वाली भपने सुवर्णं सदृश, कोमल एवं मांसल और सुन्दर ्रङ्गों से मृदंग को लिपटाए श्रौर नयन मूंदे सो रही थी

verses.sloka: याः च्यवन्ते अम्बरात् ताराः पुण्य शेष समाव्Rताः ।इमाः ताः सम्गताः क्Rत्स्ना इति मेने हरिः तदा ॥५-९-४३॥
verses.transliteration: yāḥ cyavante ambarāt tārāḥ puṇya śeṣa samāvRtāḥ ।imāḥ tāḥ samgatāḥ kRtsnā iti mene hariḥ tadā ॥5-9-43॥

translations.english: Seeing those women lying together Hanuman imagined them to be numerous meteors dropped from heaven after enjoying their merits, enjoyed and exhausted.
translations.hindi: एक कृशोदरी रति फे श्रम से थक कर, ग्रपनी भुजाश्रों में ढोलक को दबाएं सो रही थी

verses.sloka: ताराणाम् इव सुव्यक्तम् महतीनाम् शुभ अर्चिषाम् ।प्रभा वर्ण प्रसादाः च विरेजुः तत्र योषिताम् ॥५-९-४४॥
verses.transliteration: tārāṇām iva suvyaktam mahatīnām śubha arciṣām ।prabhā varṇa prasādāḥ ca virejuḥ tatra yoṣitām ॥5-9-44॥

translations.english: It was clear that the grace and lustre of those women looked brilliant like the lustre and grace of brilliant stars releasing an auspicious glow.
translations.hindi: कोई डमरूप्रिय स्त्री, डमरू को छाती से चिपटाए ऐसे पड़ी सो रही थी, मानों कोई वालवत्सा कामिनी अपने बच्चे को दिपाए पड़ी सोती हो

verses.sloka: व्याव्Rत्त गुरु पीन स्रक् प्रकीर्ण वर भूषणाः ।पान व्यायाम कालेषु निद्रा अपह्Rत चेतसः ॥५-९-४५॥
verses.transliteration: vyāvRtta guru pīna srak prakīrṇa vara bhūṣaṇāḥ ।pāna vyāyāma kāleṣu nidrā apahRta cetasaḥ ॥5-9-45॥

translations.english: Garlands displaced and jewels scattered, they were drowsy due to drink and sexual exercise.
translations.hindi: कोई कमलनयनी मदिरा के नशे में बेहोश हो, श्राडम्बर नाम के बाजे को भुजाग्रों में दबाए सो रही थी

verses.sloka: व्याव्Rत्त तिलकाः काश्चित् काश्चिद् उद्भ्रान्त नूपुराः ।पार्श्वे गलित हाराः च काश्चित् परम योषितः ॥५-९-४६॥
verses.transliteration: vyāvRtta tilakāḥ kāścit kāścid udbhrānta nūpurāḥ ।pārśve galita hārāḥ ca kāścit parama yoṣitaḥ ॥5-9-46॥

translations.english: A few young women had their circular vermilion mark (on the forehead) smudged, some had their anklets loosened and a few had their necklaces.
translations.hindi: एक श्रौरत जल के कलसे ही को लिपटा कर, सो गई थी । कलसे के जल से वह तर थी। इससे उसकी ऐसी शोभा जान पड़ती थी, मानों वसन्तकाल में फूलों की माला को ताजी ( कुम्हलाने न पावे ) रखने के लिए, उस पर जल छिड़का गया हो

verses.sloka: मुखा हार व्Rताः च अन्याः काश्चित् प्रस्रस्त वाससः ।व्याविद्ध रशना दामाः किशोर्य इव वाहिताः ॥५-९-४७॥
verses.transliteration: mukhā hāra vRtāḥ ca anyāḥ kāścit prasrasta vāsasaḥ ।vyāviddha raśanā dāmāḥ kiśorya iva vāhitāḥ ॥5-9-47॥

translations.english: Some had their strings of pearl broken, others had their clothes slipped off, and some had their waist belts snapped. They were like young mares fallen to rest after carrying heavy loads.
translations.hindi: कोई प्रबला भ्रपने दोनों हाथों से सोने के कलसे की तरह भ्रपने दोनों कुचों को ढक कर, नींद के मारे, पड़ी सो रही थी

verses.sloka: सुकुण्डल धराः च अन्या विच्चिन्न म्Rदित स्रजः ।गज इन्द्र म्Rदिताः फुल्ला लता इव महा वने ॥५-९-४८॥
verses.transliteration: sukuṇḍala dharāḥ ca anyā viccinna mRdita srajaḥ ।gaja indra mRditāḥ phullā latā iva mahā vane ॥5-9-48॥

translations.english: With their good eartops broken and flower garlands crushed some looked like blooming creepers in a dense forest crushed by mighty elephants.
translations.hindi: एक पूर्णचन्द्राननी एवं कमलनयनी, दूसरी एक सुन्दर नितम्ब वाली स्त्री को, चिपटाए हुए नशे में चूर पड़ी सो रही थी

verses.sloka: चन्द्र अम्शु किरण आभाः च हाराः कासाम्चिद् उत्कटाः ।हम्सा इव बभुः सुप्ताः स्तन मध्येषु योषिताम् ॥५-९-४९॥
verses.transliteration: candra amśu kiraṇa ābhāḥ ca hārāḥ kāsāmcid utkaṭāḥ ।hamsā iva babhuḥ suptāḥ stana madhyeṣu yoṣitām ॥5-9-49॥

translations.english: The pearl chains, large and shining like rays of the Moon in the space between the breasts looked like sleeping swans.

verses.sloka: अपरासाम् च वैदूर्याः कादम्बा इव पक्षिणः ।हेम सूत्राणि च अन्यासाम् चक्र वाका इव अभवन् ॥५-९-५०॥
verses.transliteration: aparāsām ca vaidūryāḥ kādambā iva pakṣiṇaḥ ।hema sūtrāṇi ca anyāsām cakra vākā iva abhavan ॥5-9-50॥

translations.english: The vaidurya worn by women (on the breasts) looked like Kadamba birds while the golden chains put on by some others appeared like ruddy geese.
translations.hindi: अन्त में हनुमानजी ने देखा कि अलग एक सुन्दर सेअ पर, श्रपुवं रूपयौवनशालिनी एक स्त्री पड़ी सो रही है

verses.sloka: हम्स कारण्डव आकीर्णाः चक्र वाक उपशोभिताः ।आपगा इव ता रेजुर् जघनैः पुलिनैर् इव ॥५-९-५१॥
verses.transliteration: hamsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ cakra vāka upaśobhitāḥ ।āpagā iva tā rejur jaghanaiḥ pulinair iva ॥5-9-51॥

translations.english: Their hips were like river banks crowded with swans, karandava and Chakravaka birds shining like rivers.
translations.hindi: णियों और मोतियों के जड़ाऊ विविध प्रकार के भूषणों को पहने हुए | चह स्त्री भ्रपने सौंदयं से मानों उस उत्तम भवन को श्रलंकृत कर रही थी

verses.sloka: किन्किणी जाल सम्काशाः ता हेम विपुल अम्बुजाः ।भाव ग्राहा यशः तीराः सुप्ता नद्य इव आबभुः ॥५-९-५२॥
verses.transliteration: kinkiṇī jāla samkāśāḥ tā hema vipula ambujāḥ ।bhāva grāhā yaśaḥ tīrāḥ suptā nadya iva ābabhuḥ ॥5-9-52॥

translations.english: With their tiny bells round their girdle looking like buds, the bold golden ornaments like lotuses, their gestures of love like crocodiles and their radiant beauty like silver banks, the women looked like smoky rivers.
translations.hindi: उसके शरीर का रंग गौर था ग्रौर सुवर्ण की तरह उसके शरीर की कांतिं | थी । वह सारे रनवांस की स्त्रियों की स्वामिनी, रावण की प्यारी और परम | रूपवती मन्दोदरी थी । महाबाहु पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने उस सर्वाभरण- भूषित, मन्दोदरी की सुन्दरता भ्रौर जवानी को देख उसे सीता समझा श्रौर इससे उनका आनन्द उत्तरोत्तर बढ़ता गया

verses.sloka: मृदुष्व् अन्गेषु कासाम्चित् कुच अग्रेषु च सम्स्थिताः ।बभूवुर् भूषणानि इव शुभा भूषण राजयः ॥५-९-५३॥
verses.transliteration: mṛduṣv angeṣu kāsāmcit kuca agreṣu ca samsthitāḥ ।babhūvur bhūṣaṇāni iva śubhā bhūṣaṇa rājayaḥ ॥5-9-53॥

translations.english: The beautiful imprints made by the (heavy) ornaments on the tender limbs, breasts and nipples of some women appeared like many ornaments.

verses.sloka: अम्शु कान्ताः च कासाम्चिन् मुख मारुत कम्पिताः ।उपरि उपरि वक्त्राणाम् व्याधूयन्ते पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-५४॥
verses.transliteration: amśu kāntāḥ ca kāsāmcin mukha māruta kampitāḥ ।upari upari vaktrāṇām vyādhūyante punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-9-54॥

translations.english: Shaken by the breath released from their mouths the fringes of the garments of some women were drawn towards their faces again and againfluttering.
translations.hindi: इति दशमः सगं: ॥ वानरी प्रकृति के वशवर्ती हो, हनुमानजी मारे हषं के पूंछ को झट- कारने श्रौर चूमने लगे । ये खंभे पर बार-बार चढ़ने श्रौर वहाँ से नीचे भूमि पर कूदने लगे

verses.sloka: ताः पाताका इव उद्धूताः पत्नीनाम् रुचिर प्रभाः ।नाना वर्ण सुवर्णानाम् वक्त्र मूलेषु रेजिरे ॥५-९-५५॥
verses.transliteration: tāḥ pātākā iva uddhūtāḥ patnīnām rucira prabhāḥ ।nānā varṇa suvarṇānām vaktra mūleṣu rejire ॥5-9-55॥

translations.english: The fringes of their garments glowing beautifully close to the faces of the wives (of Ravana) with different beautiful hues, shone splendid like flags.

verses.sloka: ववल्गुः च अत्र कासाम्चित् कुण्डलानि शुभ अर्चिषाम् ।मुख मारुत सम्सर्गान् मन्दम् मन्दम् सुयोषिताम् ॥५-९-५६॥
verses.transliteration: vavalguḥ ca atra kāsāmcit kuṇḍalāni śubha arciṣām ।mukha māruta samsargān mandam mandam suyoṣitām ॥5-9-56॥

translations.english: The eartops of some women endowed with auspicious charm were swinging softly generating a gentle sound by the touch of their breath.

verses.sloka: शर्कर आसव गन्धः स प्रक्Rत्या सुरभिः सुखः ।तासाम् वदन निह्श्वासः सिषेवे रावणम् तदा ॥५-९-५७॥
verses.transliteration: śarkara āsava gandhaḥ sa prakRtyā surabhiḥ sukhaḥ ।tāsām vadana nihśvāsaḥ siṣeve rāvaṇam tadā ॥5-9-57॥

translations.english: The sweet smell of wine emitted from their mouth and the natural fragrance of their breath was refreshing to Ravana as if it was serving him at that time.

verses.sloka: रावण आनन शन्काः च काश्चिद् रावण योषितः ।मुखानि स्म सपत्नीनाम् उपाजिघ्रन् पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-५८॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa ānana śankāḥ ca kāścid rāvaṇa yoṣitaḥ ।mukhāni sma sapatnīnām upājighran punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-9-58॥

translations.english: Some women of Ravana (overcome by blind passion) smelt again and again the mouths of their cowives next to them assuming it to be Ravana's.

verses.sloka: अत्यर्थम् सक्त मनसो रावणे ता वर स्त्रियः ।अस्वतन्त्राः सपत्नीनाम् प्रियम् एव आचरमः तदा ॥५-९-५९॥
verses.transliteration: atyartham sakta manaso rāvaṇe tā vara striyaḥ ।asvatantrāḥ sapatnīnām priyam eva ācaramaḥ tadā ॥5-9-59॥

translations.english: Even though the beautiful wives (should have been angry with their cowives for smelling their mouths) they behaved pleasingly, having no freedom to act with Ravana

verses.sloka: बाहून् उपनिधाय अन्याः पारिहार्य विभूषिताः ।अम्शुकानि च रम्याणि प्रमदाः तत्र शिश्यिरे ॥५-९-६०॥
verses.transliteration: bāhūn upanidhāya anyāḥ pārihārya vibhūṣitāḥ ।amśukāni ca ramyāṇi pramadāḥ tatra śiśyire ॥5-9-60॥

translations.english: Some women slept pillowed on their arms, laying aside their adornments and others had their garment under the head as pillows and lay in sleep.

verses.sloka: अन्या वक्षसि च अन्यस्याः तस्याः काचित् पुनर् भुजम् ।अपरा त्व् अन्कम् अन्यस्याः तस्याः च अपि अपरा भुजौ ॥५-९-६१॥
verses.transliteration: anyā vakṣasi ca anyasyāḥ tasyāḥ kācit punar bhujam ।aparā tv ankam anyasyāḥ tasyāḥ ca api aparā bhujau ॥5-9-61॥

translations.english: Some women lay placing their arms on the breasts of the other while their own arms were used as pillow by another. One woman placed her head on the lap of the other and slept.

verses.sloka: ऊरु पार्श्व कटी प्Rष्ठम् अन्योन्यस्य समाश्रिताः ।परस्पर निविष्ट अन्ग्यो मद स्नेह वश अनुगाः ॥५-९-६२॥
verses.transliteration: ūru pārśva kaṭī pRṣṭham anyonyasya samāśritāḥ ।paraspara niviṣṭa angyo mada sneha vaśa anugāḥ ॥5-9-62॥

translations.english: Given to intoxication and sex, the women slept touching one another's thighs, sides, hips, back and lap of the other, with their limbs intertwined.

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यस्य अन्ग सम्स्पर्शात् प्रीयमाणाः सुमध्यमाः ।एकी क्Rत भुजाः सर्वाः सुषुपुः तत्र योषितःअन्योन्य भुज सूत्रेण स्त्री माला ग्रथिता हि सा ।माला इव ग्रथिता सूत्रे शुशुभे मत्त षट्पदा ॥५-९-६३॥
verses.transliteration: anyonyasya anga samsparśāt prīyamāṇāḥ sumadhyamāḥ ।ekī kRta bhujāḥ sarvāḥ suṣupuḥ tatra yoṣitaḥanyonya bhuja sūtreṇa strī mālā grathitā hi sā ।mālā iva grathitā sūtre śuśubhe matta ṣaṭpadā ॥5-9-63॥

translations.english: Knit with the shoulders of one another like a garland of flowers intertwined with the tipsy bees resting the women shone.

verses.sloka: लतानाम् माधवे मासि फुल्लानाम् वायु सेवनात् ।अन्योन्य माला ग्रथितम् सम्सक्त कुसुम उच्चयम् ॥५-९-६४॥
verses.transliteration: latānām mādhave māsi phullānām vāyu sevanāt ।anyonya mālā grathitam samsakta kusuma uccayam ॥5-9-64॥

translations.english: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.

verses.sloka: व्यतिवेष्टित सुस्कन्थम् अन्योन्य भ्रमर आकुलम् ।आसीद् वनम् इव उद्धूतम् स्त्री वनम् रावणस्य तत् ॥५-९-६५॥
verses.transliteration: vyativeṣṭita suskantham anyonya bhramara ākulam ।āsīd vanam iva uddhūtam strī vanam rāvaṇasya tat ॥5-9-65॥

translations.english: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.

verses.sloka: उचितेष्व् अपि सुव्यक्तम् न तासाम् योषिताम् तदा ।विवेकः शक्य आधातुम् भूषण अन्ग अम्बर स्रजाम् ॥५-९-६६॥
verses.transliteration: uciteṣv api suvyaktam na tāsām yoṣitām tadā ।vivekaḥ śakya ādhātum bhūṣaṇa anga ambara srajām ॥5-9-66॥

translations.english: It was not possible to distinguish clearly between their jewels, limbs, garments and garlands and to place them in the right spots.

verses.sloka: रावणे सुख सम्विष्टे ताः स्त्रियो विविध प्रभाः ।ज्वलन्तः कान्चना दीपाः प्रेक्षन्त अनिमिषा इव ॥५-९-६७॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇe sukha samviṣṭe tāḥ striyo vividha prabhāḥ ।jvalantaḥ kāncanā dīpāḥ prekṣanta animiṣā iva ॥5-9-67॥

translations.english: When Ravana was happily asleep, the gods of light burning on the gold lampposts gazed without winking as it were, at the women, whom they dare not gaze for fear of waking Ravana.

verses.sloka: राज Rषि पित्R दैत्यानाम् गन्धर्वाणाम् च योषितः ।रक्षसाम् च अभवन् कन्याः तस्य काम वशम् गताः ॥५-९-६८॥
verses.transliteration: rāja Rṣi pitR daityānām gandharvāṇām ca yoṣitaḥ ।rakṣasām ca abhavan kanyāḥ tasya kāma vaśam gatāḥ ॥5-9-68॥

translations.english: The women halled from the families of royal sages, ancestral deities, daityas and demons who were infatuated with him.

verses.sloka: युद्धकामेन ताः सर्वा रावणेन हृताः स्त्रियः ।समदा मदनेनैव मोहिताः काश्चिदागताः ॥५-९-६९॥
verses.transliteration: yuddhakāmena tāḥ sarvā rāvaṇena hṛtāḥ striyaḥ ।samadā madanenaiva mohitāḥ kāścidāgatāḥ ॥5-9-69॥

translations.english: Many were brought by Ravana as captives of war and some came on their own deluded by lust.

verses.sloka: न तत्र काचित् प्रमदा प्रसह्य ।वीर्य उपपन्नेन गुणेन लब्धा ।न च अन्य कामा अपि न च अन्य पूर्वा ।विना वर अर्हाम् जनक आत्मजाम् तु ॥५-९-७०॥
verses.transliteration: na tatra kācit pramadā prasahya ।vīrya upapannena guṇena labdhā ।na ca anya kāmā api na ca anya pūrvā ।vinā vara arhām janaka ātmajām tu ॥5-9-70॥

translations.english: Except Sita no other woman among them had been taken there by force. They were won only on account of his valour and virtues. None loved any one earlier and none was married to others.

verses.sloka: न च अकुलीना न च हीन रूपा ।न अदक्षिणा न अनुपचार युक्ता ।भार्या अभवत् तस्य न हीन सत्त्वा ।न च अपि कान्तस्य न कामनीया ॥५-९-७१॥
verses.transliteration: na ca akulīnā na ca hīna rūpā ।na adakṣiṇā na anupacāra yuktā ।bhāryā abhavat tasya na hīna sattvā ।na ca api kāntasya na kāmanīyā ॥5-9-71॥

translations.english: None among them was born of a lowly family, nor lacked beauty, kindness, skill, strength or brightness. No one was not lovable to Ravana.

verses.sloka: बभूव बुद्धिः तु हरि ईश्वरस्य ।यदि ईद्Rशी राघव धर्म पत्नी ।इमा यथा राक्षस राज भार्याः ।सुजातम् अस्य इति हि साधु बुद्धेः ॥५-९-७२॥
verses.transliteration: babhūva buddhiḥ tu hari īśvarasya ।yadi īdRśī rāghava dharma patnī ।imā yathā rākṣasa rāja bhāryāḥ ।sujātam asya iti hi sādhu buddheḥ ॥5-9-72॥

translations.english: 'If the lawful wife of Rama born of a good family can be allowed to remain with Rama in the same way as the consorts of the lord of demons, how fortunate it would be, thought the wise lord of monkeys'.

verses.sloka: पुनः च सो अचिन्तयद् आर्त रूपो ।ध्रुवम् विशिष्टा गुणतो हि सीता ।अथ अयम् अस्याम् क्Rतवान् महात्मा ।लन्का ईश्वरः कष्टम् अनार्य कर्म ॥५-९-७३॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ ca so acintayad ārta rūpo ।dhruvam viśiṣṭā guṇato hi sītā ।atha ayam asyām kRtavān mahātmā ।lankā īśvaraḥ kaṣṭam anārya karma ॥5-9-73॥

translations.english: Hanuman once again assuming his true form said to himself, 'Sita is surely a virtuous lady superior to and more distinguished than them all. Alas, this lord of Lanka committed an ignoble, act (by abducting her). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
